title: Queue variable-length records in a ring
audience: Students with basic programming knowledge learning assembly
prerequisites: Full-width pointers and saved-register call interfaces
Binary record fields and failure preservation
learningObjectives: Maintain circular FIFO state with explicit occupancy
Distinguish empty records from empty queues
Handle independent head/tail wraps and exact fits
Preserve state on failure and allow a larger-destination retry
Compare equivalent copy orders and bounded wrap calculations

inputDomain.queueState: well formed; no corruption recovery promised

progression.localImplementation: Native prose and worked states, incremental assembly edits, and callable final-program grading
